screen.boardraid.mode_rules.classic_body:
5×5 board — both players race on the same board
First to complete 15 tasks wins
Casual matches do not affect ranked score
screen.boardraid.mode_rules.portal_body:
Both players enter a world with the same seed and follow the same stronghold order
Each new stronghold is worth 1 point; first to 5 points wins
Up to 3 stronghold-change votes per match
screen.boardraid.mode_rules.treasure_bod:
Both players enter a world with the same seed and follow the same route of 12 buried treasures
Open the target chest and carry an axe, pickaxe, shovel, iron bucket, boat and door to complete the point
Each completed point is worth 1 point; first to 5 points wins
The closer you are, the bigger the Treasure slice in the Shift+F3 pie chart (only within 128 blocks)
Entering a new point clears your inventory and restores your health
screen.boardraid.mode_rules.most_percent:
Both players enter a world from the same seed and complete as many advancements as possible within 20 minutes
The seed comes from the ranked seed library; if it is empty, one is picked at random
A 10-second vote at the start decides whether both get an infinite elytra: Use is preselected, and it applies only if both agree
The elytra can be dropped freely; dying or changing the seed re-issues the elytra and unlimited fireworks to both players
Changing the seed needs both players to agree; advancements reset to zero and the clock starts over
Equal advancement counts are a draw, and this mode does not allow resetting the world

screen.boardraid.settings.performance.sy: Reads and writes the vanilla option directly. Synchronous writes favor data integrity on crashes and may add stalls on slow disks; turning them off may improve some I/O behavior but is not guaranteed. The new value applies the next time a world is created or loaded and does not change how existing chunks are stored. If StandardSettings is installed, its preset may overwrite this vanilla value the next time a world is created; this row always shows the current vanilla value.
